title: EOS E2E Test — read-only intake verification
intent:
Validate the full GitHub Issue → EOS → Claude → EOS completion → ChatGPT notification path using a harmless read-only repository task.

Required work:
- Verify that `docs/DECISIONS.md` contains Decision #100 describing the GitHub-Issue adapter to the existing EOS intake.
- Confirm the decision states that GitHub label acceptance starts validation and EOS acceptance remains a separate governed event.
- Do not modify repository files, permissions, variables, workflows, branches, issues, pull requests, or production state.
- Return a concise verification result with the exact durable EOS status/result artifacts required by the existing runtime.

Completion:
Mark the EOS work complete through the normal governed runtime and emit the normal completion/review-ready signal back through EOS. This is an end-to-end path test; do not introduce special-case notification behavior for this issue.

source.provenance: Authenticated GitHub owner issue labeled eos-intake

authority.basis: EOS accepted the validated, Owner-submitted, explicitly scoped Issue under the issue-intake policy.
